final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_difference FROM budget WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) AS baseline_average FROM status_averages) SELECT event_status, avg_difference, avg_difference - baseline_average AS difference_from_baseline FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE baseline_average IS NOT NULL
